input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 binds us (the Company): we may not participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and HDI gains the exclusive right to use our own "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer site. The restriction runs for the entire term, which under Section 4.1 is one year automatically renewing on each anniversary, so it exceeds 12 months, and there is no automatic performance-based exit for service level or delivery date failures (Section 1.6 gives only a discretionary termination right if the Site is late). The sole carve-out in Section 6.2 (closeout merchandise) does not cure this. That is exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance exit — walk-away territory rather than the fallback. Section 6.3, which restricts HDI, benefits us and is untouched. We therefore propose the preferred cure: Section 6.1 is replaced with a non-exclusivity statement that also removes HDI's exclusive brand right, leaving the HDI-side restriction and the trademark licence intact.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.

proposal.summary: Remove the Company's exclusivity obligation and HDI's exclusive "Deerskin" brand right in Section 6.1.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.1 locks us out of any similar Internet project for the whole (auto-renewing) term and hands HDI an exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand, with no performance-based exit. We have replaced it with a non-exclusivity statement; if HDI needs some protection we could instead cap exclusivity at a single 12-month period for Deerskin Products that ends automatically on any service level or delivery date failure.
